name: Isifo seswekile
tagline: Esona sifo sikhula ngokukhawuleza esingapheliyo eMzantsi Afrika.

urgent.heading: Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177 okanye uye ngqo esibhedlele ukuba
urgent.primary_message: Iswekile yegazi ephezulu kakhulu okanye ephantsi kakhulu inokubeka ubomi esichengeni kwiiyure nje ezimbalwa. Le miqondiso ithetha - musa ukulinda.
red_flags: Unxano olugqithisileyo ngokuphefumla ngokukhawuleza-inokuba sisifo seswekile ketoacidosis (DKA)
Isiqhamo okanye ukupholisa inzipho umoya (umzekelo weDKA)
Isicaphucaphu esikhulu kunye nokugabha kunye neentlungu zesisu
Iswekile yegazi ephantsi — ukungcangcazela, ukubila, ukubhideka okungaphucukiyo neswekile
Unyawo okanye umlenze obonisa ngokukhawuleza usulelo okanye ibala elimnyama (unyawo lweswekile)

what_is_it.heading: Isifo seswekile ngokwemiqathango ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Isifo seswekile yinto eyenzekayo xa umzimba wakho ungakwazi ukuyilawula kakuhle iswekile esegazini lakho. Mhlawumbi i-pancreas yakho ayenzi i-insulin eyaneleyo (Uhlobo loku-1), okanye umzimba wakho uyayeka ukuphendula kwi-insulin ngokufanelekileyo (Uhlobo 2).
paragraphs: I-insulin yihomoni exelela iiseli zakho ukuba zikhuphe iswekile (iswekile) egazini kwaye ziyisebenzisele amandla. Ngaphandle kwe-insulin eyaneleyo - okanye ngeeseli ezingayinakiyo - iswekile yakha egazini kwaye yonakalise imithambo yegazi, imithambo-luvo, amehlo, izintso kunye neenyawo kwiminyaka.

Udidi loku-1 ludla ngokuqala ebuntwaneni okanye ebudaleni obuncinci kwaye lufuna inaliti ye-insulin ubomi babo bonke. Uhlobo lwe-2 - ngokude luxhaphake kakhulu - lukhula ekukhuleni kwaye ludibaniswe ngokusondeleyo nobunzima, ukutya, imbali yentsapho kunye nobuhlanga. Uhlobo lokuqala lwe-2 ngamanye amaxesha lunokuguqulwa ngokutya kunye nokunciphisa umzimba kuphela.

items.headline: 4.5 yezigidi
items.body: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika baphila nesifo seswekile. Phantse isiqingatha asazi ukuba banayo.

items.headline: Uhlobo 2 = 90%
items.body: Uninzi lwesifo seswekile kubantu abadala ludidi lwe-2 - ludityaniswe kakhulu nobunzima, imbali yentsapho kunye nokutya.

items.headline: Ukhathalelo lwasimahla
items.body: Ukuhlolwa kwesifo seswekile, amayeza aselelweyo, kunye ne-insulin zonke zisimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente.

items.headline: Inokubuyiselwa kwangethuba
items.body: Uninzi lwezigulana ezisanda kufunyaniswa zisanda kuxilongwa zingabuyela kwiswekile yegazi eqhelekileyo ngokutya, ukunciphisa umzimba, kunye nokuzilolonga.

pull_quote.text: Rhoqo ngonyaka iikliniki zibona izigulana zilahlekelwa ziinzwane, izintso, namehlo ngenxa yesifo seswekile - phantse rhoqo ngenxa yokuba eso sifo sasihamba phambili ngaphambi kokuba sivavanywe. Zivavanye. Isimahla.

signs.heading: Yintoni onokuyibona
signs.lede: Isifo seswekile sinokukhula ngokucothayo ekuhambeni kweminyaka (uHlobo lwesi-2) okanye sivele kwiiveki nje ezimbalwa (uHlobo loku-1). Iimpawu zakudala kulula ukuziphosa - kwaye abantu abaninzi abanayo kwaphela de kuvele iingxaki.

items.title: Ezintathu zakudala
items.description: Ukuchama rhoqo, unxano olunzulu, kunye nokuncipha kwesisindo esingachazwanga - ngakumbi kunye, ngakumbi kwiiveki ezimbalwa.

items.title: Ukudinwa nokuphola kade
items.description: Ukudinwa okungaqhelekanga, ukubona luzizi, ukusikeka kunye nosulelo oluthatha ixesha elide ukuphola, igwele rhoqo okanye usulelo lokuchama.

items.title: Uhlobo loku-1 lweempawu zesilumkiso
items.description: Ukuncipha ngokukhawuleza kwesisindo ngonxano olugqithisileyo, ngakumbi kubantwana okanye kubantu abadala. Ukugabha, ukuphefumla nzulu ngokukhawuleza, ukuphefumla okuneziqhamo, ukozela — unxunguphalo.

items.myth: Isifo seswekile sibangelwa kukutya iswekile eninzi.
items.fact: Iswekile inegalelo ekuzuzeni ubunzima, nto leyo engumngcipheko. Kodwa i-genetics, ukumila komzimba, ubuhlanga, kunye nokutya ngokubanzi kubaluleke ngaphezu kweswekile yodwa.

items.myth: Ukuba awuyidingi i-insulin, isifo sakho seswekile asikho nzulu.
items.fact: I-Type 2 yeswekile ibangela iingxaki ezininzi - ukuhlaselwa yintliziyo, ukubetha, ukungaboni, ukusilela kwezintso, ukunqunyulwa kwamalungu - njenge-Type 1.

items.myth: Abantu abanesifo seswekile abanakuze baphinde bayitye iswekile kwakhona.
items.fact: Izixa ezincinci zeswekile kwisidlo esilungeleleneyo zihlala zilungile. Eyona nto ibalulekileyo yindlela yokutya, kungekhona ukutya okukodwa.

items.myth: Ukuba isifo seswekile sinosapho lwam, akukho nto ndinokuyenza.
items.fact: Indlela yokuphila inciphisa umngcipheko we-2 ngaphezu kwe-50%, kunye nembali yosapho eyomeleleyo. Imfuza ilayisha umpu; ubomi butsala umdla.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa umngcipheko wakho
prevention.lede: Uthintelo lunamandla kakhulu xa luqalisiwe phambi kokuba kuvele iingxaki. Ukuba unomzali, umntakwenu, okanye umntwana onoHlobo lwesi-2 - umngcipheko wakho uphezulu kakhulu kwaye imiba yokuhlola.

items.title: Ubunzima obunempilo
items.description: Ngokukodwa esinqeni. Ukulahlekelwa yi-5-10% yokunciphisa ubunzima bomzimba Uhlobo lwe-2 ingozi ngaphezu kwesiqingatha.

items.title: Hambisa yonke imihla
items.description: Imizuzu ye-30 yomsebenzi ophakathi - ukuhamba, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili, ukulima, ukudansa - iintsuku ezininzi zeveki.

items.title: Ibhalansi yepleyiti
items.description: Gcwalisa isiqingatha seplate yakho ngemifuno, ikota eneprotheni ephilileyo, ikota kunye neengqolowa ezipheleleyo. Sika iziselo ezineswekile kuqala - impembelelo enkulu.

items.title: Isikrini ukuba sisemngciphekweni
items.description: Imbali yentsapho, ukutyeba, iminyaka engaphezu kwama-40, imbali yesifo sikashukela sokukhulelwa - cela uvavanyo lweswekile yegazi ngomnwe. Isimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki.

items.title: Zivavanye
items.description: Uvavanyo lweswekile yegazi lusimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki nakwiikhemesti ezininzi. Ukufunda ngokungaqhelekanga ngaphezu kwe-11, okanye ukuzila ukutya ngaphezu kwe-7, kubonisa isifo sikashukela.

items.title: Ukuba ufunyanisiwe, qalisa unyango
items.description: Ukutya kunye nokuzilolonga kukodwa kunokusebenzela udidi lwesi-2 lwakwangoko. Uninzi lwabantu ekugqibeleni luya kufuna iyeza lomlomo okanye i-insulin. Zonke zisimahla kwiikliniki zikarhulumente.

items.title: Thatha amayeza yonke imihla
items.description: Nangeentsuku uziva uphilile. Ingakumbi ngeentsuku oziva uphilile. Isifo seswekile siyawenza umonakalo sithe cwaka ngelixa iswekile iphezulu.

items.title: Hlola iinyawo zakho yonke imihla
items.description: Isifo seswekile siyonakalisa imithambo-luvo ezinyaweni zakho - unokufumana amanxeba amabi kwaye ungaziva. Jonga, ivumba, uzive. Jonga ekliniki nasiphi na isilonda esingapholiyo.

items.title: Ukuhlolwa kwamehlo kunye nezintso ngonyaka
items.description: Isifo samehlo seswekile kunye nesifo sezintso zithe cwaka de zidlulele phambili. Iitshekhi zonyaka zizifumana ngexesha lokuthatha inyathelo.

get_help.heading: Uqale phi
get_help.lede: Ukhathalelo lwesifo seswekile eMzantsi Afrika lusimahla kwindawo yesidingo. Indawo enzima iyaqala - wakuba uyenzile, inkqubo yekliniki inokuthwala umthwalo omninzi.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Iklinikhi nganye karhulumente ibonelela ngovavanyo lwasimahla lweswekile, amayeza, kunye ne-insulin
